principle: detect first, correct second, never force by default

minimum_visible_wrapper: literal PORT_32BIT=Y before discovery only for ARMHF

single small launcher (Limbo shape): control.txt chain, get_controls, GAMEDIR from $directory, durable log.txt, single-instance flock on the binary, foreground game with signal forwarding and re-wait for the child's true exit status, console reset, pm_finish exactly once
durable early error log when discovery or data extraction fails
no bash runtime library and no deployment receipt in generated output
must_not_contain: forced SDL video or audio backend

portmaster_discovery.strategy: probe regular control.txt files by capability and allow control.txt to publish the canonical root

discovery_only_unverified.MIYOO_EX: candidate root only; no fixture or runtime evidence; unsupported/unverified
discovery_only_unverified.RetroDECK: candidate environment root only; no fixture or runtime evidence; unsupported/unverified

control_txt.status: required for real PortMaster execution, optional only for isolated diagnostics

funcs_txt.compatibility_rule: probe each function; the numeric version is diagnostic and is not a feature substitute

constraints: CFW_NAME contains only ASCII letters, digits, period, underscore or hyphen
the file stays under the selected controlfolder
the file is regular and not a symlink
absence is normal and causes no fallback forcing

mapping_precedence: mapping generated or selected by the active control.txt
existing SDL_GAMECONTROLLERCONFIG_FILE selected by the firmware

integrated_stick_hint.scope: host-wide diagnostic for the integrated controller, never per-pad truth
integrated_stick_hint.activation_policy: never create bindings or enable D-pad fallback automatically

get_controls.empty_mapping_policy: log it and do not invent VID/PID mappings
get_controls.failure_policy: log a warning and preserve the firmware environment

pm_platform_helper.required_argument: real executable path that will own the display
pm_platform_helper.order: after host paths and before any extractor/setup UI or game launch
pm_platform_helper.semantics: platform hint only; it does not execute the game
pm_platform_helper.failure_policy: best effort, log status and continue

dialog_handoff.capability_signal: a live non-symlink FIFO published as PM_PIPE by PortMaster
dialog_handoff.order: after pm_platform_helper and before any extractor/setup UI or game launch
dialog_handoff.success_postcondition: PortMasterDialogExit returns zero and the exact PM_PIPE path no longer exists
dialog_handoff.failure_policy: fail closed with a durable runtime error when PM_PIPE is not a live non-symlink FIFO, the close API is absent, returns nonzero or leaves PM_PIPE active
dialog_handoff.scope: close only the exact PortMaster-owned dialog; never scan or signal ambient processes

pm_finish.semantics: PortMaster-owned cleanup; the framework does not duplicate it
pm_finish.failure_policy: log status without replacing the game status

armv7.port_32bit_semantics: declares an already-32-bit port to static launch scanners and platform mods; it neither proves nor converts ELF ABI

architecture.release_rule: ARMHF and AArch64 use separate ELF artifacts under one source/API contract

libraries.private_provider_policy: bundle only dependencies proven missing; reject private EGL, GL, GLES, GBM, DRM, Mali and Mesa providers

environment.backend_rule: a backend is activated only after a runtime capability probe proves it is required
environment.device_info_rule: CFW_NAME and DEVICE_NAME are logged facts, never sufficient conditions for a compatibility fix

package_installation.items_semantics: required top-level ownership entries; a trailing slash identifies a directory
package_installation.items_opt_semantics: optional ownership entries installed and permission-fixed only when present
package_installation.split_root_semantics: HarbourMaster moves top-level .sh launchers to scripts_dir and all other members to ports_dir
package_installation.overlay_update_semantics: an update may leave an older same-name file in place; the 0.6.0 launcher is self-contained (no sourced runtime library), so overlay staleness reduces to the launcher file itself, which records its generator version in its header and first log line
security: normalize top-level metadata into the first port directory
package_installation.owner_data: PortMaster installs the package; NXExtract validates and prepares user-owned game data during launch, in foreground and before the game

facts: FAT and exFAT may not preserve Unix executable bits, ownership, symlinks or advisory-lock behavior
ZIP extraction and firmware installers can normalize permissions differently
a firmware label does not prove the filesystem mounted for a particular port
launcher_rules: invoke vendored shell helpers explicitly through bash when an executable bit is not required
keep instance locks in an owned runtime or private tmp directory, never beside game data
use PortMaster bind_files or bind_directories only when the port needs them and the active funcs.txt actually defines them
treat a missing optional bind capability as a logged compatibility result, not permission to invent a host-wide workaround
forbidden_assumptions: chmod on the game-data filesystem will persist
flock exists or behaves like util-linux
all saves should be redirected merely because one CFW commonly uses exFAT

frontend_and_signals.frontend_return: exit the launcher after pm_finish and let the existing frontend supervisor resume
forbidden_framework_actions: start, stop, restart, enable, disable or mask a frontend service
kill a frontend or desktop process
log out, lock, suspend, reboot or power off the host
create a detached game with setsid
frontend_and_signals.signal_scope: only the exact direct child PID created by the bootstrap, revalidated with proc starttime
frontend_and_signals.multiple_instance_policy: fail closed on the per-port lock; never scan and kill ambient matching processes

facts: PortMaster commonly lives under /roms/tools
ports live under /roms/ports
sudo may be supplied through ESUDO
control may be under /opt/system/Tools or /storage/.config
ROCKNIX may use a Sway fullscreen helper
32-bit mods may publish PipeWire plugin paths
canonical controlfolder is /mnt/mmc/MUOS/PortMaster
scripts and port data can be split across mmc or sdcard
controller mapping is generated by the active muOS control
PortMaster data may be in XDG_DATA_HOME
ports use /userdata/roms/ports
save redirection may require bind helpers on exFAT
TrimUI control roots and script roots are platform-specific
ZIP extraction may not preserve executable bits
PortMaster supplies platform-specific controls
MIYOO_EX is a discovery-only candidate with no fixture/runtime evidence and remains unsupported/unverified
RetroDECK may publish a Flatpak data root
the candidate has no fixture/runtime evidence and remains unsupported/unverified
PortMaster data uses /storage/roms/ports and launchers can use /storage/roms/ports_scripts
the current integration aliases NextOS to EmuELEC and supplies its own controller bridge
a legacy global compatibility hook is negative evidence and must not be copied into the shim

prohibited_generalizations: Pikmin, PartyBoard or any GTA port proves universal compatibility
one working Mali-450 port proves all Mali-450 devices
one Panfrost port proves proprietary Mali behavior
a firmware name proves a backend is usable
a WIP or abandoned port is a positive source
